text: On the last night. <break time="0.8s" /> While John was away in town. <break time="0.8s" /> As soon as the moonlight came. <break time="0.8s" /> And that poor thing began. <break time="0.8s" /> To shake the pattern. <break time="0.8s" /> I got up and ran to help her. <break time="0.8s" /> I pulled and she shook. <break time="0.8s" /> I shook and she pulled. <break time="0.8s" /> And before morning. <break time="0.8s" /> We had peeled off yards of that paper. <break time="0.8s" /> A strip as high as my head. <break time="0.8s" /> I locked the door. <break time="0.8s" /> And threw the key down. <break time="0.8s" /> Into the front path. <break time="0.8s" /> For I did not want anybody to come in until John came home. <break time="0.8s" /> Now I creep smoothly. <break time="0.8s" /> Around the room. <break time="0.8s" /> For my shoulder just fits. <break time="0.8s" /> In that long smooch around the wall. <break time="0.8s" /> So I cannot lose my way. <break time="0.8s" /> I do not like to look. <break time="0.8s" /> Out of the windows for there are so many creeping women outside. <break time="0.8s" /> And I wonder. <break time="0.8s" /> Whether they all came out of the wallpaper. <break time="0.8s" /> As I did. <break time="0.8s" /> When John came. <break time="0.8s" /> And found the door locked. <break time="0.8s" /> He cried for an axe. <break time="0.8s" /> But I told him in the gentlest voice. <break time="0.8s" /> That the key was by the front steps. <break time="0.8s" /> Under a plantain leaf. <break time="0.8s" /> He came in at last. <break time="0.8s" /> And stopped short by the door. <break time="0.8s" /> But I kept on creeping just the same. <break time="0.8s" /> Looking at him over my shoulder. <break time="0.8s" /> I have got out at last. <break time="0.8s" /> Said I. <break time="0.8s" /> In spite of you and Jane. <break time="0.8s" /> And I have pulled off most of the paper. <break time="0.8s" /> So you cannot put me back. <break time="0.8s" /> Now why should that man have fainted. <break time="0.8s" /> I wondered. <break time="0.8s" /> For he fell right across my path. <break time="0.8s" /> By the wall. <break time="0.8s" /> So that I had to creep over him. <break time="0.8s" /> Every time.
